name: Dutch Baby / Skillet German Pancake
whyItWorks: Egg-heavy, zero-fiber batter that puffs up like a Yorkshire pudding - feels fancy, costs pennies, and takes almost no digestive work.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Whisk 2 eggs, 1/2 cup white flour, 1/2 cup lactose-free milk, and a pinch of salt. Pour into a hot skillet with 2 tbsp melted butter. Bake at 425F for 15 mins until puffed and golden. Dust with powdered sugar and maple syrup.
